claims: The 2026 UFL season features eight teams.
Play in the 2026 UFL season begins on March 27, 2026.
The 2026 UFL consists of five returning teams: Birmingham Stallions, Dallas Renegades, DC Defenders, Houston Gamblers, St. Louis Battlehawks.
The 2026 UFL consists of three new franchises: Columbus Aviators, Louisville Kings, Orlando Storm.
Birmingham Stallions play at Protective Stadium.
Columbus Aviators play at Crew Stadium.
Crew Stadium was formerly the Michigan Panthers' stadium.
Dallas Renegades play at Toyota Stadium.
Toyota Stadium was formerly the Arlington Renegades' stadium.
DC Defenders play at Audi Field.
Houston Gamblers play at Shell Energy Stadium.
Louisville Kings play at Lynn Family Stadium.
Orlando Storm play at Inter&Co Stadium.
St. Louis Battlehawks play at The Dome at America's Center.
The Michigan Panthers, Memphis Showboats, and San Antonio Brahmas did not return for the 2026 UFL season.
